cost_definition: Stop: actual cached probe_ndis/probe_latency_ms. Fallback>10: probe plus selected-budget distance_computations/mean_latency_ms. No traversal reuse assumed.
effectiveness_source: Existing per-query/per-budget top10 sweep at selected efSearch; ef10 probe work matches original ef10 sweep for every query. Probe result IDs were not saved separately; deterministic same-index/budget equivalence is assumed.
limitations: Score spread is a simple confidence heuristic, not relevance or calibrated query-level risk probability.
Calibration is used for candidate selection; Wilson is pointwise with no multiple-selection correction or formal held-out risk guarantee.
Only one feature family and one two-stage policy are tested; no LADR/official DARTH/official Patience claim.
Cached budget selection is not actual in-traversal early termination; selected-search reuse is not assumed.
Latency combines saved probe timing and selected-budget mean; p95 is across query estimates, not end-to-end request percentiles; policy overhead not measured.
Top10 caches do not contain compatible policy Recall@100; values remain blank, not inferred from another task.
Only 43 OOD queries; empirical safety rates may be imprecise.
selection_rule: Require training and calibration two-sided 95% Wilson upper<=target; minimize calibration mean realized work, then calibration violation, training work, fallback ef, candidate ID
threshold_candidate_generation: Approximate probe_gap_1_10 training-only quantiles at 0,5,...,100 percent plus always-fallback; fallback10 canonicalized
